sentences.text:
2. The present appeal has been filed:
for the offence punishable under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the POCSO Act in POCSO Case /Registration No. 26 of 2021 arising out of Mahila (Bhabua) P.S. Case No. 46 of 2021 through Judgment and order dated 17-7- 2023 and 21-7-2023 respectively as passed by learned court of special Judge, POCSO Court cum Additional Sessions Judge, VI th, Kaimur at Bhabua (Bihar) namely Ashutosh Kumar Upadhyay and the appellant has Patna High Court CR.

entities.text: POCSO Court cum Additional Sessions Judge, VI th, Kaimur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: APP (SJ) No.4570 of 2023(7) dt.06-02-2025 punished Rigorous Imprisonment of 10 years and fine of rupees 50,000/- under 4 of the POCSO Act, 2012.

In default of payment of fine,
further R.I. for 6 months.

3. It has been pointed out by learned State Counsel that despite the order having been passed and the appellant convicted under the POCSO Act, the informant has not been implicated as party respondent.

4. List this case on 20.03.2025.
